SAPScriptLine.SAPScriptLineText: SimpleMDG is a no-code platform for master data governance built on SAP
BTP. It empowers business users to manage master data processes directly
— eliminating the need for custom development or prolonged IT
In this 40-minute session, you’ll get a hands-on look at the platform,
explore key features, and learn how organizations use SimpleMDG to
accelerate data initiatives for both SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments.
The main transaction to monitor an ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) run is ATC
itself, where you navigate to ATC Administration > Monitor and Control
Runs. You can also use the transaction SE80 to access the ATC Result
Browser to view the results of a completed check run.
